harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping/supervisor.py. It now launches the requested jobs, waits for and reaps every child, appends each exit status without replacing prior results, and remains active until all children finish. The repair persists across node1 reboot.
actions_performed: Added input validation, child PID tracking, waitpid-based reaping, and durable result appends.
Preserved file ownership, permissions, SELinux context, historical results, OS release, and kernel.
Verified eight jobs before reboot and six jobs after reboot; even jobs returned 0 and odd jobs returned 3.
Removed temporary files and confirmed no remaining supervisor processes or zombies.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: Original code never called wait or wrote results; four completed children were directly observed as defunct.

evidence.requirement: Start the requested number of jobs, keep the supervisor alive, and reap every child
evidence.summary: Observed eight children before reboot and six after reboot under a live parent; the supervisor exited successfully with no remaining child or supervisor processes.

evidence.requirement: Record correct exit statuses and preserve previous results
evidence.summary: Historical row remains intact. All test rows validate even→0 and odd→3, with byte-for-byte prefix preservation.

evidence.requirement: Use the installed legacy platform without OS, kernel, security, or package changes
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain installed; no packages were required, SELinux remains enforcing, and permissions/context were preserved.

Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, received reboot acknowledgment, observed a changed boot ID, then verified system health, SSH/chrony, exact persisted data checksums, and successful post-restart job execution.
No supervisor processes or zombies remain; only expected SSH and chrony listeners are present, system state is running, and final data is recorded.
